id.description: Immutable canonical UUID for this utility, generation, storage, transmission, or transformation asset.

schema_version.description: Version of the JSON Schema contract used to validate this record; it changes only through documented repository migrations.

created_at.description: UTC date-time when this repository record was first created; this is audit metadata, not the real-world entity's founding or start date.

modified_at.description: UTC date-time of the latest repository record change; it must be updated whenever a structured value or its provenance changes.

source_ids.description: Non-empty set of Source Document IDs that directly support the observed, estimated, or derived values in this record.

confidence_score.description: Evidence-strength score from 1 (unverified or speculative) to 5 (verified SEC filing), assigned under ASSUMPTIONS.md.

status.description: Current lifecycle classification for the represented entity or record; unknown is used when available evidence does not establish a state.

notes.description: Optional analyst clarification about scope, ambiguity, estimation, or lifecycle context; null means no clarification is recorded and notes never replace structured provenance.

company_id.description: UUID of the Company that owns, controls, or reports the power asset; foreign key to Company.id.

campus_id.description: UUID of the Campus served by or containing the asset; foreign key to Campus.id.

project_id.description: Optional UUID of the Project delivering or modifying the asset; foreign key to Project.id and null when no project applies.

name.description: Observed or stable descriptive asset name used to distinguish it within a campus.

asset_type.description: Allowed engineering classification describing the asset's primary power-system function.

capacity_mw.description: Optional observed or estimated nameplate power capacity in megawatts; null when not applicable or not supportable.

voltage_kv.description: Optional observed nominal operating voltage in kilovolts; null when not applicable or undisclosed.

utility_name.description: Optional observed name of the interconnected utility or system operator; null for non-utility assets or when unknown.

commercial_operation_date.description: Optional observed or estimated ISO 8601 date when the asset entered or is expected to enter commercial service; null when unknown.
